reasons.ha_restart: the zone has 1 compute node(s); it needs 2
reasons.live_migration: the zone has 1 compute node(s); it needs 2
reasons.load_balancer_ha: the zone has 1 compute node(s); it needs 2
reasons.separate_edges: the zone has 1 server(s); edges on separate VMs start at 3

storage_durability_reason: the zone keeps one copy of every volume (Ankra Local on its node); Ankra Storage starts at 3 storage hosts; back volumes up to an off-host vault
ceph_tiers_unavailable_reason: Ankra Storage is not active in the zone yet
warnings: local volumes have no backup target; configure a backup vault for region
volumes are single copies without a backup outside the zone: region  has no backup vault
recovery_reason: volumes live on one host and region  has no backup vault: a lost host's servers return only with the host
gateway_redundancy_reason: the zone has one gateway: its public networking stops while that host is down
uplink_redundancy_reason: no gateway uplink is recorded for the zone
